x-openregister._seedDataNote: Seed objects MOVED to lib/Settings/profiles/*.json (OpenSpec change seed-profiles). A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

Goal.title: Goal
Goal.description: An organisation goal (quality objective, ISO 9001 §6.2): a measurable, owned, deadlined objective set at a governance body's level (council, board, department, commission, via GovernanceBody.bodyType), monitored via a declarative progress rollup from linked Toezegging commitments and ActionItem tasks, and optionally cascaded from a parent Goal (single-level only, see parentGoal). Goal is the target end of the accountability chain that Toezegging and ActionItem already track day-to-day (organisation-goals REQ-001).

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, organisation-goals REQ-003). Canonical dialect (keyword 'initial', never 'initialState'/'states'-only/'default'). draft -> active | abandoned; active <-> at-risk, active -> achieved | abandoned; at-risk -> achieved | abandoned. achieved and abandoned are terminal (no outgoing transition). No app-side state machine.

title.title: Title
title.description: Short name of the goal. Required.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the goal is trying to achieve and why. Required.
description.example: Structurele omzetgroei realiseren binnen de duurzaamheidsdoelstellingen van de raad van bestuur.

horizon.title: Horizon
horizon.description: The planning cadence the goal is set at. Required.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Reference to the Person responsible for the goal. Optional: a goal may be collectively owned by its body before an individual is assigned (organisation-goals REQ-002 Scenario 2).

body.title: Governance body
body.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody (council/board/department/commission) the goal is set at. Required; GovernanceBody.bodyType already spans every organisational level a goal can be scoped to (organisation-goals REQ-002).

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: Date the goal period starts. Optional.

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.description: Date by which the goal should be achieved. Required.

status.title: Status
status.description: Goal status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): draft -> active <-> at-risk -> achieved | abandoned. achieved and abandoned are terminal.

targetValue.title: Target value
targetValue.description: The measurable target the goal aims for (ISO 9001 §6.2 'measurable'). Optional; paired with currentValue and unit.

currentValue.title: Current value
currentValue.description: The measured progress toward targetValue as of the last update. Optional.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Unit of measure for targetValue/currentValue (free text: e.g. '% omzetgroei', '% CO2-reductie behaald'). Optional.

parentGoal.title: Parent goal
parentGoal.description: Optional, self-referential reference to a parent Goal, enabling an org-wide -> department -> quarterly cascade. Single-level only: childGoalCount on the parent counts DIRECT children only, never grandchildren (organisation-goals REQ-005 Scenario 2, design.md D3), a deeper cascade is out of scope for this change.

commitmentSettlementRate.title: Commitment settlement rate
commitmentSettlementRate.description: Share of this goal's linked commitments that are settled, as a percentage. Materialised by OpenRegister on save from x-openregister-calculations. Never written by decidiq.

actionItemCompletionRate.title: Action item completion rate
actionItemCompletionRate.description: Share of this goal's linked action items that are completed, as a percentage. Materialised by OpenRegister on save from x-openregister-calculations. Never written by decidiq.

childGoalAchievedRate.title: Child goal achieved rate
childGoalAchievedRate.description: Share of this goal's direct child goals that are achieved, as a percentage. Materialised by OpenRegister on save from x-openregister-calculations. Never written by decidiq.

childGoalCount._note: Declarative progress rollup (ADR-031, organisation-goals REQ-005), identical dialect to Meeting's totalParticipantCount/actionItemCount (lib/Settings/decidesk_register.json ~line 2226). This is the FIRST self-referential use of this dialect in Decidiq (Goal -> Goal via parentGoal, proposal.md Risk 1) — verify at seed-import/live-read time; if the aggregation engine rejects a same-schema filter target, this field degrades to absent rather than failing the whole schema (per proposal.md Risk 1 / DEFERRED_QUESTIONS, recorded in tasks.md Task 6).

Self-referential by design: Goal counts its DIRECT children via parentGoal, never grandchildren (organisation-goals REQ-005 Scenario 2). Declared here as well as under x-openregister-aggregations because the two blocks feed different readers. AggregationController serves the reporting block, and CalculationPayloadBuilder reads only this one, injecting each result as @aggregate.<name>.
